title: Intermediate Construction Safety Specialist | PANYNJ sites and facilities
description:
Title:
Intermediate Construction Safety Specialist | PANYNJ sites and facilities

Client:
Our client is a highly respected civil engineering firm, established in 1999 and recognized among NJBIZ's Top 25 Engineering Firms. With a team of experienced engineers and inspectors, the firm has played a key role in delivering landmark transportation projects across New York and New Jersey.

Description:
Under the supervision of the Construction management division, immediate need for three individuals to perform technical and administrative duties essential to ensure that contractors will conduct all their activities in compliance with Federal, State, and Local fire and safety regulations. Home base for this position will be at a PANYNJ facility nearby. Site interaction could be at any of the PANYNJ sites in the region.

Responsibilities:
  • Review contracts, drawings, and project-related documentation.
  • Ensure that contractors are in compliance with OSHA, FDNY, NYCDOB, local laws, etc.
  • Review contractor health and safety plans.
  • Monitor work conditions, operations, practices, construction equipment to evaluate effectiveness and adherence to regulations.
  • Provide the PANYNJ with daily reports including photos.
  • Conduct accident investigations.
  • Interact with PANYNJ Resident Engineers, and agency safety representatives.
Qualifications:
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in construction safety.
  • Possess a valid NYC DOB Site Safety Supervisor card (SST).
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Possess a valid OSHA 30-hour construction safety certificate.
  • Possess a valid driver’s license.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of construction safety standards and regulations.
  • Familiar with Fire Codes and FDNY regulations and procedures.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of hazard recognition and assessment.
  • Must communicate effectively.
Education:
Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management or Safety desired but not required. MUST have OSHA and SST certifications.

To Apply:
If you have the knowledge, skills, and experience for this role, please attach your resume and email it directly to recruiters@careerpointstaffing.com .

title: Intermediate Mechanical Engineer | Commercial, Retail, Residential and Industrial buildings
description:
Title:
Intermediate Mechanical Engineer | Commercial, Retail, Residential and Industrial buildings

Client:
One of New Jersey's preeminent Architectural and Engineering firms which has grown into a full-service Design firm that provides a single point of accountability for all aspects of design services. The firm's size and abilities enable it to handle a broad spectrum of projects while allowing the principals to put their seal on everyone. With in-house Civil, Structural, Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing and Fire Protection Engineering, all aspects of a project can be designed and managed by one firm.

Description:
Urgent need for an Intermediate-level Mechanical Engineer to design and prepare specifications for HVAC systems and other building related mechanical equipment. Should have experience with commercial, multi-family, mixed-use and residential design.

Requirements:
  • 4-7 years of experience developing designs and preparing specifications of HVAC systems and other building related mechanical equipment (plumbing, sprinklers, etc.)
  • Prepare markups and changes for HVAC equipment.
  • Assist in obtaining equipment specifications from equipment vendors.
  • Attending meetings, preparing meeting minutes, conducting site visits, and field inspections as required.
  • Prepare all construction drawings and reports.
  • Proficient with AutoCAD and/or Revit MEP
Education:
BS Mechanical Engineering
